what_it_is: EtherealX (Ethereal Exploration Guild) is a Bengaluru launch-vehicle startup building Razor Crest Mk-1, a fully reusable medium-lift rocket targeting roughly 8-tonne-class payloads with aggressive per-kilogram price claims. Founded by former industry engineers, the company raised a $5M seed in 2024 and a $20.5M round announced in January 2026, with TDK Ventures and Accel reported among backers.
india_angle: If flown as designed, Razor Crest Mk-1 would be India's first fully reusable medium-lift vehicle, filling the launch-capacity gap between small-lift private rockets (Vikram-S, Agnibaan) and ISRO's LVM3 - directly relevant to India's planned 2026-2028 private constellation build-out.
intelligence_assessment: EtherealX has credible institutional backing and a clear reusable-vehicle thesis, but no orbital launch or first-stage recovery has been publicly demonstrated yet. Treat engine test progress, static-fire milestones and revised launch dates as the honest indicators; price-per-kg claims are vendor projections, not market evidence.

faq.a: Razor Crest Mk-1, a fully reusable medium-lift launch vehicle aimed at large payloads with low per-kilogram launch pricing.
Reported backers include TDK Ventures and Accel; the company announced a $20.5M Series A in January 2026.
No orbital launch has been publicly demonstrated; the programme remains in development.
